items.headline: DPP reviewing major CUP for Hoakalei West Lagoon lūʻau (1,200 guests)
items.summary: Haseko seeks CUP-Major 2026-CUP-36 for a permanent West Lagoon lūʻau; staff recommend approval with TIAR/TMP and noise conditions, and the Neighborhood Board asked for a public Tripoli–Keoneʻula connection.
items.place: Ocean Pointe / Hoakalei, Waipana Street, TMK 9-1-134:081
items.timeline: Decision due August 27, 2026; completion scheduled Q2 2030
items.governmentParties: Department of Planning and Permitting; Neighborhood Board

items.headline: HHFDC: DLNR still owns A99-728 parcels; D.R. Horton land swap has not occurred
items.summary: As of August 5, 2026, DLNR remains fee owner of the listed East Kapolei parcels after HCR 85 HD1 urged transfer to HHFDC, and HHFDC has not yet determined whether District Boundary Amendment changes are needed.
items.source: Hawaii Housing Finance and Development Corporation
items.timeline: Land-transfer MOU being drafted; no completion date identified
items.governmentParties: Hawaii Housing Finance and Development Corporation; Department of Land and Natural Resources; Land Use Commission
items.sourceFile: P:\PolicyDocuments\DPSCP\Ewa\2nd Five Year Review 2024\Development Updates\Status_Response to LUC letter_08052026_final (part 1) - signed.pdf

items.headline: City establishes emergency access route for Makakilo
items.summary: DEM announced an emergency-only route via an MOU with unnamed private landowners so first responders can open access if Makakilo Drive is blocked; residents may use it only when officials activate it.
items.sourceFile: P:\PolicyDocuments\DPSCP\Ewa\2nd Five Year Review 2024\Development Updates\emergency access route for Makakilo - EIN Presswire.pdf

items.headline: Civil Beat: Hawaiʻi childcare deserts among nation’s worst; ʻEwa Beach cited
items.summary: Civil Beat reports that Hawaiʻi’s licensed-childcare deserts are among the nation’s worst and names ʻEwa Beach as a scarce-supply community.
